notes.title: Early access and first day patch
notes.content:
Friends, we can finally say it: the Heart of Altai game has gone into Early Access and is available for purchase!

As it often happens during releases, today we have already prepared the first day patch thanks to your feedback.

[b]The update includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] autoloading edits
[*] selectable loading of locations
[*] clickability of locations
[*] exit from 1 location is available 
[/list]

The next major update with achievements will be released in 1.5-2 weeks.

If you have been waiting for a sign from above to go on a virtual expedition to one of the most mysterious corners of the planet - Altai, here it is! This is not just a simulator of walks. It is a history of the region with magical nature, original people, unusual traditions and religion.
We have put everything into the project: respect for the Altai Republic, where we have visited ourselves, attention to details and love for beautiful landscapes.

[b]Now it is your turn to discover Altai as we have seen it. Your feedback is very important! We will be guided by the feedback and improve the project.[/b]
